To whom it may concern,

I am writing about the agent who served me at your Abu Dhabi Airport desk on 21 October around 7pm. I did not catch his full name but his tag said Faisal. When I asked politely about the insurance options he rolled his eyes, talked over me and said that if I did not like the terms I could go elsewhere. He was also on his phone while handing me the keys. I have rented from you before and never experienced this kind of attitude. Please take it up with him.

Thanks,
Linda Roberts
